overview: The main thread today is AI agents touching money. An Axios scoop says banks are finding unauthorized AI agents in customer accounts, while Coinbase and Grok Bot push deeper into agent access to financial accounts. Also notable: SpaceX is finalizing a $40B debt raise at higher rates, Dwarkesh's Intel fab episode flags a chipmaking tool bottleneck, and Microsoft reports an AI diagnosis result published in Science.

top_items.title: David Sacks - Disputes an Axios scoop on rogue AI agents in bank accounts, saying most activity is user-authorized and not cyberattacks
Chamath Palihapitiya - SpaceX is finalizing a $40B debt raise, with its riskiest slice at about 8.3%, per Semafor
Dwarkesh Patel - Intel's CTO says today's global tool stock could only double leading-edge wafer output, while AI compute grows 3x a year
Mustafa Suleyman - Microsoft says in a Science paper that its MAI Diagnostic is 1.7x more accurate than ER doctors who can use the web
Brian Armstrong - Coinbase launches a page for connecting ChatGPT, Grok or Muse to research, manage and trade crypto and stocks
Sarah Guo - Kevin Weil's Warp Sciences raises a $215M Series A led by Lightspeed for AI and robotics drug-discovery labs
Bill Ackman - Gave bullish public remarks on Fannie $FNMA and Freddie $FMCC, and endorsed a summary calling current valuations 'absurd'
Matthew Berman - In his interview, Sam Altman says OpenAI's edge is that its internal models are far ahead of its public ones
